Jeffrey Gates decreased its stake in Davita Inc (DVA) by 19.97% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gates Capital Management Inc sold 481,094 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.22% with the market. The hedge fund run by Jeffrey Gates held 1.93 million shares of the hospital and nursing management company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $139.32M, down from 2.41M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gates Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Davita Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.68 billion market cap company. (NYSE:DVA) has declined 2.38% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.93% the S&P500.
